reasoning: On the season so far the Celtics are the stronger team; with home court the Celtics start about 13 points better, in a game of about 219 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Celtics.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Celtics win 87 times in 100, by about 14; most games like this end between 193 and 242 total points.

analyst.text: Boston blew a 17-point lead in Denver for their first back-to-back losses since March. Jayson Tatum's technical helped seal it ('That's on me'), so there is a response motive. Sacramento play the second night of a back-to-back after the worst homestand in franchise history, with Sabonis unhappy and coach Doug Christie under pressure. The angle leans towards Boston.
